Scriptor primæ & antiquissimæ historiæ mundi & ecclesiæ & Dux populi Israëlitici ex Ægypto per divisum mare rubrum egredientis, & in deserto vagantis annos XL.

page.notes: The Greek-style initial letters "M" in "Moses" and "Æ" in "Ægypto" are decorated, and the "Moses" paragraph opens with a large swash M. The word "INTRO-" is printed at the foot right as the start of the next page's heading, a catchword with a hyphen, and is kept as printed. Faint show-through of the reverse page is present and omitted. Two small dots/specks on the page are not printed text and are omitted. The line "divisum" is printed with the long s as "divisum" (plain s), and "Israëlitici" keeps the diaeresis as printed.
